name: menu
description: Three equal horizontal menu strokes with rounded free ends in a solid filled style.
authorship: Original geometry constructed for this project; no third-party icon paths used.
construction: Owner requested a boxed Filled Menu. Three straight equal centerlines run x=4.85..19.15 at y=6,12,18 with unchanged Regular 1.70 and round .85 caps. The shared glyph has visible bounds x=4..20 and y=5.15..18.85. Filled adds the family radius-4 box at 2..22, with the exact three capsules as negative space. Left/right are the primary inner pair, with 2px clearances; top/bottom retain 3.15px clearances and natural bar spacing. The box has 2px artboard margins on all four sides. Outline and Filled glyphs are identical in position and weight. Native X/Y=100%, rotation=0. Round 4 draft awaiting owner review.
